sloka: इति उक्त्वा न्यवसत् तत्र राघवः सह लक्ष्मणः ।बहु दृश्य दरी कुंजे तस्मिन् प्रस्रवणे गिरौ ॥४-२७-२९॥
transliteration: iti uktvā nyavasat tatra rāghavaḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ ।bahu dṛśya darī kuṁje tasmin prasravaṇe girau ॥4-27-29॥

translations.english: Having said so, Rama resided with Lakshmana on the Prasvarana mountain with many beautiful caverns and shrubs of vines.
